items.t: Te Whakatōhea mourns pou tikanga Dr Te Riaki Amoamo
items.s: For more than 60 years, Dr Te Riaki Amoamo passed on the reo, whakapapa and tikanga of Te Whakatōhea so younger generations could stand and speak for their people.

items.t: Māori Queen makes historic visit to Tai Rāwhiti
items.s: The Poukai is an annual circuit of visits by Te Arikinui to marae associated with the Kiingitanga.

items.t: Ngāi Tūhoe mourns treasured son Tā Pou Temara
items.s: The celebrated academic, author, historian and teacher — a leading voice in tikanga, reo and history — returned to Mataatua marae, to his hapū Te Urewera.
